title: דאני לי מארחת את שורד השואה אברהם רוט- FIGHTING TO REMEMBER

segments.title: Early Life and Persecution
segments.summary: Avraham describes his early life in a liberal Orthodox family in Holland. He explains how everything changed when the Germans arrived and began stripping away their basic rights.

segments.title: Invasion and Jewish School
segments.summary: The sudden bombing of Holland takes everyone by surprise and brings a constant feeling of dread. Avraham recalls attending a segregated Jewish school where classmates and teachers would suddenly disappear.

segments.title: Ghettos and Deportations
segments.summary: Avraham's family is forced into a ghetto, and he witnesses the brutal deportation of orphans and neighbors. He shares how his mother temporarily saved them from a raid by claiming he had cholera.

segments.title: Hiding and Battle of Arnhem
segments.summary: The Dutch underground helps hide Avraham and his brothers on separate farms. While in hiding, he witnesses paratroopers landing and fighting during the Battle of Arnhem.

segments.title: Trauma and Legacy
segments.summary: Avraham explains why his family never spoke about the Holocaust at home due to their deep trauma. He emphasizes the importance of sharing his story so future generations understand the reality of war and never forget.
